pictures.name: SH3-The-Lit-Home
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Seen from the doorway of a simple ancient stone home on Friday night: two oil lamps glow on a table set with a white cloth and braided bread under a cover; in the back a neatly made bed with a woven blanket. a bearded Jewish man in his forties in a simple brown wool robe and a dark head covering steps in, smiling; a Jewish woman in her thirties with a deep blue head scarf and a cream dress greets him. pictures.name: SH4-Amen
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. In the doorway of the same lamplit home, two tall gentle angels in simple flowing robes, one made of warm golden-white light, the other of cool silver-gray shadowy light, faces soft and serene. The golden angel raises one hand in blessing over the room; the gray angel bows his head and lowers his eyes, quietly agreeing despite himself. Soft, gentle, a little wry. Warm light inside, blue night outside.

pictures.name: SH5-Dark-Home
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A different ancient stone home on Friday night, dim and unready: a cold unlit lamp, an empty bare table, a rumpled bed, only moonlight through the door. In the doorway stand two tall gentle angels in simple flowing robes, one made of warm golden-white light, the other of cool silver-gray shadowy light, faces soft and serene; now the gray angel lifts his hand and the golden angel bows his head. Quiet, not frightening, a gentle cautionary mood.
